instruction: Guide me in accessing the Oilify filter dialog.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to navigate GIMP menus to open the Oilify filter window. The evaluator uses the existing check_include_exclude metric to verify that 'filters-oilify' appears in GIMP's action-history file. This is similar in complexity to the original Vignette filter task - both require simple menu navigation in GIMP. The postconfig closes GIMP and handles any dialogs. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: State extraction logic is correct: Reading GIMP's action-history file is the appropriate way to verify that the Oilify filter window was opened, as GIMP records all user actions in this file
Metric comparison logic is appropriate: check_include_exclude correctly verifies that 'filters-oilify' appears in the action history while ensuring no error messages are present
Data flow is semantically correct: The getter extracts action-history content as text, and the metric checks for the presence of the expected action name
Expected value is correct: 'filters-oilify' matches GIMP's internal action naming convention for the Oilify filter
Complete instruction coverage: The evaluator fully verifies that the Oilify filter window was opened
Postconfig is appropriate: Properly closes GIMP and handles dialogs to ensure the action-history file is flushed and can be read
No runtime feasibility issues: The command, file path, and metric function all work correctly together
